verdict.rationale: Gemini's Notebooks let you "organize your projects in a dedicated, focused space" and provide "a continuous chat experience that remembers your sources, instructions, and ongoing discussions" [gemini-docs-24, gemini-docs-11]. Together these cover the core of grouping chats and files with shared context and instructions, and Gems add reusable custom instructions [gemini-docs-9]. The evidence is only short snippets, though. Missing for 10: detail on how multiple chats and files are grouped and managed within a notebook, any limits on sources per notebook, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Gemini app notebooks.
